requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only one translucent glass hand and a small blank squeeze bottle are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, nothing beneath the nozzle, and nothing else enters the frame at any point. Nothing anywhere glows, lights up or turns amber at any moment; the hand, the bottle and the fluid all stay the same soft pale cyan from the first frame to the last. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the hand rolls the bottle over nozzle-down and the thumb and two fingers settle onto its soft sides, and the camera pushes in and tilts down until the nozzle tip sits in the upper half of the frame with empty void under it. 1.5-3s: the fingers press in one short slow squeeze and a single pale drop swells at the nozzle tip, hangs there a beat, then falls straight down and out of the bottom of the frame. 3-4.5s: the fingers release and the soft sides spring back with a faint dimple, and after a clear pause a second drop forms and falls exactly the same way — one squeeze, one drop, one pause, never a stream. 4.5-6s: a third drop swells and the wrist tilts the bottle a few degrees so that drop falls just off to one side, then the hand holds the bottle dead still with a fresh bead of clear fluid hanging at the tip until the very last frame, the dark slate blue-grey void staying empty. The hand stays translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; nothing in the frame carries printed markings of any kind. The audio is a low synth drone with a soft squeeze and one faint drip on each drop, no music, no dialogue.
